scope: Production pure C# frame quantities; no live AutoCAD validation.

result.scope: Production pure frame quantity contract; not live CAD freshness, DWG integration, UI or installer.

cases.name: six physical roles: independent endpoint lengths, counts and no invented cladding geometry
helpers belong to one physical part and every link is checked
all catalog and geometric grouping dimensions remain distinct
length is actual installed length without rounding or stock substitution
missing linear length stays null and partial
known and unknown lengths cannot silently produce a complete total
missing catalog properties remain explicit and partial
unknown warnings aggregate with all physical source identities
nonpositive and nonfinite physical lengths refuse
unsupported role refuses instead of becoming a generic piece
frame passports reject invented cladding shape and area
same position or equal dimensions with different physical identities count twice
identical physical and report duplicates count once
reused physical identity with changed length coating or system refuses
reused report identity detects changed fingerprint and source revision
same CAD handle is rejected case insensitively
missing and malformed CAD links refuse
unselected physical members and their CAD links are still validated
zone selection and whole-selection grouping preserve exact provenance
shared physical part needs its whole scope
zone display separators cannot collide
estimates remain separate from installed counts and stock lengths
partial estimate group is omitted without blocking installed subset
frame estimate inclusion is independent of cladding cutting toggle
unselected estimate groups are omitted and separate complete groups survive
estimate numeric JSON roundtrip preserves duplicate identity
invalid estimate rows and invalid group scopes refuse
stock estimate contract rejects unsupported fitting procurement
unselected estimate data is validated before selection
source engineering limitations are retained without granting engineering approval
source partial status and explicit source issues are never promoted
verified zero is an empty installed result with explicit information
bad schema document scope and selection refuse
frame and cladding reports cannot be silently mixed
rows are deterministic and aggregation does not mutate passports
estimate row order remains deterministic when only total length differs
unique identities require no canonical duplicate keys
canonical identity work is triggered by a repeated identity only
